articles.title: Crypto exchange MNX takes on OKX, Bitget offering pre-IPO futures for AI giants
articles.snippet: MNX is offering a different way to trade the future valuations of private AI companies, including OpenAI, Anthropic and DeepSeek.

articles.title: Bitcoin diverges from South Korean stocks as AI concerns deepen the Kospi selloff
articles.snippet: South Korea’s chipmakers lead another sharp selloff as concerns over AI spending and Chinese competition grow, while bitcoin holds well above its summer lows.

articles.title: Standard Chartered offers RLUSD custody in Dubai and plans LMAX collateral link
articles.snippet: Ripple previously gave LMAX $150 million in financing to integrate RLUSD into its institutional infrastructure.

articles.title: Bitcoin keeps up pressure on $84K as US stocks skirt Korea tech sell-off
articles.snippet: Bitcoin price action preserved overnight gains as US stocks quickly rebounded after opening lower on the back of Korea’s tech-stock rout.

articles.title: Digital cash offers ‘cash-like privacy,’ but bank data breaches threaten users: BIS
articles.snippet: BIS said that digital cash can achieve “cash-like privacy,” however, the technology isn’t yet production-ready due to risks such as bank data breaches.
